summary.overview: In Meghalaya, Khasi and Jaintia communities grow Living Root Bridges (Jingkieng Jri) from aerial roots of Ficus elastica trees using betel nut guide trunks. Roots fuse via inosculation (vascular grafting) over decades, strengthening with age. In Assam, the Hargila Army led by Dr. Purnima Devi Barman protects endangered Greater Adjutant Storks and nesting trees. Birds build nests using twigs for structure and moss/cotton for thermal insulation.
